name: Discussing Your Work Experience
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on discussing your work experience -- practice these key phrases out loud:
I've been in this role for about three years now.
Before this, I worked on the operations side of the business.
One project I'm particularly proud of is...
I'm looking to grow more into a leadership role going forward.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
